designationHistory.indexText: Established in March 1991, the fourth national wildlife refuge set up specifically to protect bald eagles.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: James River National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1991 to conserve fish and wildlife which are listed as endangered or threatened species, and to protect bald eagles.
